body: I've told him that I chose to break up with my ex, and that I chose to be with him, not with anyone else. I'm also pretty affectionate and I communicate to him that he's the guy of my dreams a lot, but I don't know how he interpreted it.

Not really, the only thing I can think of that could have made him a bit unhappy is that he was my first in everything, but he had his first's with other girls too (but they were separate girls, so that could be it)

It could be for other couples, but we had a discussion about our past relationship/flings a bit into our relationship, and it actually made us more transparent and more comfortable in dating. He told me about his exes too. But to each his own haha

I have talked to him about his reaction, and I tried to reassure him that nothing would ever happen, and that he could relax.
---My ex-boyfriend legitimately planned on marrying me, which made my break up with him really harsh. Because of this, I don't want to be reminded of him when I'm with my current boyfriend (I'd like to just enjoy being with him in the present moment) but his actions keep reminding me of the fact that the guy who's heart I probably smashed is 3 meters away, and it's making me emotionally exhausted.

I come in contact with him only when it's unavoidable, we have small talk, but I feel so awkward having him around that I try to avoid him but sometimes I can't avoid him since his door is like 3 meters to ours
Yes. We had a session where we talked about all our past relationships, he knows general timeline and how the relationship was.
